Package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.inventory

Interface InventoryWrapper

All Superinterfaces:
Iterable<org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack>
All Known Subinterfaces:
CountableInventoryWrapper
public interface InventoryWrapper extends Iterable<org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack>
Wrapper to handle inventory/fake inventory/custom inventory etc.

    • createSnapshot

      @NotNull default @NotNull org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack[] createSnapshot()
      Create an Inventory snapshot (including Empty slots). QuickShop-Hikari will shoot a snapshot for inventory used for purchase failure rollback. Note: provide an invalid snapshot will cause rollback break whole Inventory! WARNING: High recommend to override this method, default method doing by badways and low-performance, may mess up Inventory item order.
      Returns:
      The inventory contents for snapshot use.
